subject: Mathematics

show.line: This bar graph shows how children get to school. Walking is the tallest bar. Let's read it closely!

rounds.prompt: How many children come by taxi? Read the bar.
Which way do the fewest children use?
rounds.praise: Yes! Bicycle is the shortest bar.

rounds.prompt: Twelve walk and eight come by taxi. How many more walk? Say the number.

rounds.story: Twelve walk, eight ride a taxi, five come by car, two cycle. How many children in the class?

rounds.prompt: Here is a table of rainy days. Which month had the most rain?
Which graph matches the table? March had the most rainy days.
rounds.praise: Yes! The March bar is the tallest.

rounds.prompt: Is this true? More children walk than ride a taxi.
rounds.praise: Yes! Twelve is more than eight.

hints: Read the number at the top of each bar.
To find how many more, take the small number away from the big one.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find how many more walk than cycle.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Twelve walk and two cycle. Twelve plus two. Fourteen more!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! How many more means take away. Twelve take away two is ten.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's take away together. Twelve take away two. Ten more children walk!

parent_line: Can read a bar graph and a table and compare the numbers.
